<issue_to_address>
**Variant-specific prereleases are ignored**

When same-name locked variants have different `allow-prereleases` policies, `find_latest_package` takes `allows_prereleases()` from the first root dependency with this name for every locked variant, so `VersionSelector` can choose the wrong candidate and `--latest` or `--outdated` reports an incorrect version or status for the other variant.

Select the dependency matching each locked variant's active markers and source when determining its prerelease policy.
</issue_to_address>
